
{{alias}}( f, a, b, maxIter, xtol, rtol, args )
    Finds a zero of a continuous function `f` on the interval `[a, b]`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    f: Function
        Objective function.

    a: number
        Lower bound.

    b: number
        Upper bound.

    maxIter: integer
        Maximum number of iterations.

    xtol: number
        Absolute tolerance.

    rtol: number
        Relative tolerance.

    args: Array
        Callback function arguments.

    Returns
    -------
    results: Object
        Solution object.

    Examples
    --------
    > function f( x ) { return x*x - 1.0; };
    > var out = {{alias}}( f, 0.0, 2.0, 100, 2e-12, 8.88e-16, [] );
    > out.root
    1.0

    See Also
    --------
